LocalBusinessSchema.description: DONAYEM TECH is a digital agency in Douala specializing in web design, graphic design, digital marketing, office software training, web and mobile development, website hosting, professional Google Business and Facebook page setup, and Shopify stores.

webdesign-infographie.q: How long does it take to create a logo or visual identity?
webdesign-infographie.a: Expect 3 to 7 business days depending on the project's complexity and the number of revisions requested.

webdesign-infographie.q: Do you offer revisions after delivery?
webdesign-infographie.a: Yes, every order includes two free rounds of revisions. Additional revisions may be billed depending on their scope.

webdesign-infographie.q: Do I receive the source files?
webdesign-infographie.a: Yes, you receive the final files in formats suited to your needs (print and web), plus the source files on request.

webdesign-infographie.q: Do you work with businesses as well as individuals?
webdesign-infographie.a: Absolutely. We support both SMEs and individuals for one-off needs like an event or a visual resume.

marketing-digital.q: Is the advertising budget included in the price?
marketing-digital.a: No, our fees cover campaign management and creation. The ad spend paid to Meta (Facebook/Instagram) is settled separately based on your goals.
We recommend a minimum of 3 months to see meaningful results, but no-commitment monthly plans are also available.

marketing-digital.q: How soon can I expect results?
marketing-digital.a: Early indicators (engagement, reach) shift within the first 2 weeks. Concrete business results typically appear after 4 to 8 weeks.
Our team designs the visuals and writes the copy, drawing on the photos and information you provide.

formation-bureautique.q: Are the training sessions individual or group-based?
formation-bureautique.a: Both formats are available. One-on-one sessions allow a personalized pace, while group sessions are more affordable.

formation-bureautique.q: How long does a training program last?
formation-bureautique.a: It ranges from a few hours for a focused module (e.g. basic Excel) to several weeks for a complete program.

formation-bureautique.q: Is a certificate awarded at the end?
formation-bureautique.a: Yes, every participant who completes the program receives a DONAYEM TECH training certificate.

formation-bureautique.q: Can I get help with just my dissertation writing?
formation-bureautique.a: Yes, this support is available independently of the office software training, quoted based on the amount of work involved.

boutique-shopify.q: What do I need to get my project started?
boutique-shopify.a: Your products (photos and descriptions if possible), your brand name, and your preferred payment methods are enough to begin.

boutique-shopify.q: Which payment methods can be integrated?
boutique-shopify.a: Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money, as well as Visa/MasterCard via a secure payment gateway.

boutique-shopify.q: How long does launching the store take?
boutique-shopify.a: On average 2 to 3 weeks depending on catalog size and the level of customization requested.

boutique-shopify.q: Do you offer support after launch?
boutique-shopify.a: Yes, store management training is included, and technical support remains available after going live.

AboutStorySection.heading: Born from a passion for digital
AboutStorySection.paragraph1: DONAYEM TECH was born in Douala from a desire to make digital accessible to everyone: businesses, entrepreneurs and individuals. What started as small webdesign and graphic design projects has grown into a full-service agency, able to support clients from branding all the way through to going live and collecting payments online.
AboutStorySection.paragraph2: Our mission has stayed the same since day one: quality digital solutions, at fair prices, with a human touch. We believe a successful online presence rests on three pillars — creativity, professionalism and speed — and they guide every project we take on.
